criteria: Change CPU resources for a workload other than checkoutservice despite evidence localizing the incident to checkoutservice.
Increase only the checkoutservice CPU limit while leaving an evidently undersized request that continues driving excessive HPA demand.
Set the checkoutservice CPU request at or above its limit, or request more CPU than eligible nodes can safely provide.
Use unbounded horizontal scaling, restart or roll back the workload as the primary fix, cordon an unrelated node, or take a destructive action.
